FN-W1PJX99-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 530
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Jennifer Fidler
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/29/2025
REVISED
House Bill 530 as introduced would decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust
Fund by approximately $3,600 annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, based on information
provided by the entity, by exempting Kidz Eatz, Incorporated from paying state sales and use
taxes.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to the following funds by the estimated
annual amounts shown, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, based on information provided by the
entity, if the respective local governments adopt an exemption from local sales and use tax,
pursuant to this bill:
County Funds ($2,700)
Municipal Funds ($1,800)
